title: x-image
description: Shape of the `x-image` block that bounds each image file an input names. It sits on the `items` of an array input declared as an attachment; the array's own `minItems`/`maxItems` bound the count. JSON Schema has no keyword for a referenced file, and validators ignore unknown keywords, so the eval-schemas check validates every block against this schema. An SDK that loads a contract with `x-image` must enforce every field here, on every file, before any model call, or refuse the contract.

formats.description: Accepted media types. The three every supported provider takes natively.

detect.description: The format is read from the file's leading bytes, never from its extension or a content-type header.

min_edge.description: Smallest allowed width and height, in pixels.

max_edge.description: Largest allowed width and height, in pixels.
